scripts.dev: concurrently -k -t 'HH:mm:ss' -p '[{time}] {name}' -n Backend,Frontend,Downloader,Database -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "cd backend && UVICORN_RELOAD_EXCLUDE='*.db timing/*' PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 uv run uvicorn main:app --reload" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix downloader start" "cd database && uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8001"
